summary: The purpose of this report is to seek City Council's approval to terminate the Offer to Donate (the "Offer") between the City and Mount Pleasant Group of Cemeteries ("MPGC") for the property comprising a portion of the lands known as York Cemetery at 101 Senlac Road, Toronto shown as Parts 1, 2 and 3 on Plan 66R-29405 (the "Lands") attached hereto as Appendix "A".
decided: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the Offer to Donate between the City and Mount Pleasant Group of Cemeteries in respect of the lands shown as Parts 1, 2 and 3 on Plan 66R-29405 attached as Appendix A to the report (January 31, 2018) from the Director, Real Estate Services, to the earlier of March 30, 2019 or thirty (30) days following the dismissal or settlement of the legal proceeding between Friends of Toronto Public Cemeteries Inc. and Kristyn Wong-Tam and Her Majesty the Queen in Right of Ontario, the Public Guardian and Trustee and Mount Pleasant Group of Cemeteries. 2. City Council authorize the City Solicitor to amend the Offer to Donate to give effect to the above on such terms and conditions as the City Solicitor may from time to time consider reasonable.
